caers-balance-of-nature-whole-produce-ve.summary: Shoppers have reported experiencing diarrhoea shortly after taking the capsules [1185], while others described severe pain, nausea, vomiting, and difficulty swallowing along with emergency care and hospitalization [1186, 1187]. One report also mentioned kidney-related issues including stones and swelling [1187]. These reports look related because all involve the same product taken recently and describe serious digestive or abdominal problems occurring in a similar time frame.

web-bag-of-chips-walmart.summary: One person reported that after eating this Walmart bag of kettle brand chips, which was the only change in their diet, they began experiencing severe diarrhea and had to run to the bathroom seven times that day [1826].

web-plant-based-nuggets-reaction-fred-me.summary: One person who ate the Fred Meyer Plant-Based Nuggets (labeled as Gardein Ultimate Plant Based Chick’n Nuggets) reported feeling a wave of tingles throughout their body while eating, with the sensation returning that night. The next morning they experienced explosive diarrhea, stomach cramping, and gas [1860]. There is only one report available.

web-juice-particles-kroger.summary: One shopper who bought Kroger juice reported seeing particles in it and developed diarrhea shortly afterward. They were unsure if the particles caused their symptoms but noted it as the only unusual thing they consumed that day. There is only one report so no patterns can be established.

web-free-mac-n-cheese-walmart.summary: One person who ate Annie's gluten free mac n cheese cups from Walmart reported developing nausea, diarrhea, and vomiting shortly afterward [1818].
